prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pilot-03
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): c1fda20aaadaf66c
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback test programs divider 64 then sends 0xa5 but traps on uart timeout with no byte received, so recv_buf_valid never asserted. Expected cfg_divider=64 but byte-0 write uses cfg_divider[ 7: 1] <= reg_div_di[ 7: 0], truncating the LSB and leaving bit0 stale. This mis-programmed divider in the excerpt breaks TX/RX bit timing so the loopback byte is never sampled.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash c1fda20aaadaf66c in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
